_comment: Metadata for the Zenodo record that holds the processed Tn-seq datasets, used by
scripts/local/ytab_upload_zenodo.py. The uploader refuses to run while any field still says CHANGE ME,
so the creators have to be filled in before anything is sent. The manuscript's author list is still a
placeholder too, so this is the one place that needs a real answer first.
Fields follow Zenodo's deposition metadata schema: https://developers.zenodo.org/#representation

metadata.title: YTAB reprocessed Tn-seq datasets: Hermes, Ac/Ds and piggyBac libraries in yeasts and yeast-like fungi
metadata.description:
Published transposon-sequencing (Tn-seq) datasets reprocessed from raw reads with YTAB, one archive per dataset. Each archive unpacks into a YTAB installation as output/projects/<dataset> and output/exports/<dataset>, and carries the insertion hit files, gene summary tables, quality-control tables, normalizations, condition comparisons, essentiality calls and genome-browser tracks, with the manifest recording the command and inputs behind every output.

Covers Hermes, Ac/Ds (including SATAY) and piggyBac libraries in Candida glabrata, Candida albicans, Candida auris, Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Schizosaccharomyces pombe, Cryptococcus neoformans, Yarrowia lipolytica and Komagataella phaffii. The raw reads remain at their original SRA/ENA accessions, which each dataset's record names; these archives are the processed results, not the reads.

YTAB itself, with the catalogue that lists these datasets and the code that produced them, is at https://github.com/jayelazuno/ytab
